ValidationRule.description: Restrict User to select previous date for Scheduled Publishing of Event.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( TEXT( Manual_or_Scheduled_Publishing__c ) = "Scheduled Publishing", OR( AND( OR( ISCHANGED(Manual_or_Scheduled_Publishing__c), ISCHANGED(Event_Publishing_Date_Time__c) ), OR( Event_Publishing_Date_Time__c < NOW(), ISBLANK( Event_Publishing_Date_Time__c ), Active__c == true ) ), AND( ISCHANGED(Active__c), Active__c == true, Event_Publishing_Date_Time__c > NOW() ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If the Event Publishing is Scheduled Publishing then 1. you have to enter the date and time and it should not be in past. 2. Active checkbox should not be checked
